connections.description: External connections, one values layer per connection file. Not used by this chart.

okdp-lib-chart.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib-chart library dependency. Not a parameter.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.description: Secrets to provision. Each entry creates one Kubernetes Secret, replicated to every namespace.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the Kubernetes Secret to create.

data.title: Data
data.description: Free-form key/value pairs stored in the Secret. Values cannot be empty: nothing generates them.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Extra labels of the Secret, copied to its replicas. Database owner Secrets read by CloudNativePG managed roles need cnpg.io/reload: "true" (otherwise a role created before its Secret is replicated keeps no password).

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream chart this chart renders, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

local-secrets-provider.title: local-secrets-provider
local-secrets-provider.description: Values of the local-secrets-provider chart 0.1.0 (oci://quay.io/okdp/charts/local-secrets-provider), for example nameOverride. Refused: fullnameOverride, secrets (set them with the secrets parameter).

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
